app.name: 32X Test
app.long_description: A test of the Sega 32X on the Wii with the PicoDrive libretro core: a list of the games in 32xtest/roms, the SH-2 CPUs recompiled or interpreted, the built-in 32X BIOS or the BIOS files of 32xtest/bios, and the speed on screen (frames per second and percent of full speed). HOME, GameCube Z + Right or USB Mode + Right opens the menu.
